title: Coaching Program Engine — Meta, ManyChat and WordPress into One GoHighLevel Pipeline

sections.label: 1 · THREE SOURCES, ONE FRONT DOOR
sections.note: Meta ads, Instagram and Facebook DMs through ManyChat, and WordPress lead magnets all enter through the same door and get matched against the same contact. Someone who DMs you today and downloads a guide next week is one person in GoHighLevel, not three. Source is still tagged on the way in so you can tell where they came from.

sections.label: 2 · FOLLOW-UP THAT ACTUALLY LANDS
sections.note: First text goes out inside a minute, then the email sequence runs on spacing that survives a weekend. Every contact is pulled out of competing sequences first, which is what stops a lead getting your ad follow-up and your lead-magnet follow-up on the same afternoon.

sections.label: 3 · TIERS, PAYMENT AND ONBOARDING
sections.note: Payment and subscription live inside GoHighLevel, so a purchase moves the pipeline, tags the tier and starts the right onboarding without anyone rekeying it. A failed or cancelled payment routes into its own recovery sequence rather than being silently lost.

sections.label: 4 · EVERYTHING STAYS IN SYNC
sections.note: Status is written back to ManyChat so your DM conversations show the same picture as the CRM. This is the part that usually breaks. Two systems each holding half a customer is the reason teams stop trusting the CRM.

sections.label: 5 · SO YOUR TEAM CAN RUN IT
sections.note: Naming, tagging and pipeline stages follow one convention throughout, documented as each piece is built. The goal is that your team can add a sequence in month three without calling me.
